caveats: This is advice from data that is not certified, not a clearance. It must not be used for navigation or flight planning. The pilot checks the official publications (AIP, NOTAM).
Nothing here says what is active today. Hours, NOTAMs and activations are not known, so every airspace counts as possibly active.
A limit above ground (AGL) depends on the terrain, which is not known here. A flight level (FL) depends on the air pressure of the day.
No airspace listed does not mean free airspace. The server holds airspace for some areas and some countries only; `data` says for each source whether it reaches this place.

data.coverage: This source's data reaches the place and the whole radius. It holds the airspace of these countries only: DE, AT, CH, IT, SI, HR, HU, SK. If the place or its surroundings lie in another country, this source says nothing about the airspace there.
data.notice: OpenAIP data is not certified and must not be used for primary navigation or flight planning. Never rely on openAIP data! OpenAIP data contains errors.
data.source: Data used comes from openAIP and is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License. Visit https://www.openaip.net and contribute to better aviation data, free for everyone to use and share. (CC BY-NC 4.0)
